chapter: Paris 1951-70 and return to New York
title: Losing the job to Mr. Varna over a blue Cadillac
summary: Owner Varna, who drove a Kaiser, grew jealous of Butler's Cadillac and avoided giving him the promised orchestra leadership; Butler later returned with a better car.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Now, I lost this job and I'm going to tell you how. People can be jealous. This man, he owned, he had money's mama's.

Yeah. But he had a Kaiser, little, funny-looking Kaiser automobile. So I come here on vacation and brought back a blue Cadillac. Now, something said, Jacques -- I was driving around the corner and hide it. One night I forgot my keys had had to run real quick, so I came late. I parked the car in front of his casino and told the doorman to watch it. I ran upstairs and come back down, the doorman had gotten Mr. Varna. Mr. Varna looked at it and said, but Jacques, that's your car? I said, no, my uncle loaned it to me. So I left that night. Mr. Varna came up there, again. I looked out there and he's looking all around, looking at it real good. Now, he had promised, he said, I want you to be my orchestra leader, I want you to pick a band and be my orchestra leader, be the leader, lead the house band. I tried to get in touch with that man for about a year. That man was running and ducking and doing everything. And the contract ran out and I couldn't see him, still. The man was [unintelligible].
Yeah, that's an old story about them cars. (PHONETIC).

And about three months later, he drove up with one. Now, I went to Belgium and got another one, a later model. And I said, Mr. Varna, oh, you sure have a pretty one. "Oh, Jacques, I like that very much." I said, "That's why you fired me." [unintelligible]. I said, "You underestimated me."

He said, I really did. (Unintelligible). He laughed. And I ran around the corner, and I had a white one. And right behind it and jumped up. He said, "Butler, you've got to come back in the show." But the man died before I could get in there.
